Review comment:

- [P2] Verify the frozen source manifest before selecting scoring labels — /home/drwho1985/workspace/algotradinglife/beijing-lot/r/margin_first_mapping_evaluate_20261018.R:36-40
  If the historical input manifest changes after input freezing, evaluation accepts its replacement label paths and hashes even though the frozen inputs bind the original manifest hash in `x$source_hashes[['manifest']]`. Checking each snapshot against the newly read manifest only establishes internal consistency, so settlement updates can silently change this experiment's scoring evidence while selection replay still passes. Verify the manifest against its frozen hash before reading snapshots, and validate each row's dataset/sheet identity. This preserves the source-binding requirement in [AGENTS.md:133–137](AGENTS.md#L133-L137).
